Automation.Name: Prestige class rules automation
Automation.Hint: Integrates every Grimoire prestige class with dnd5e, Midi-QOL and active effects.

StrictPrerequisites.Name: Enforce prestige class prerequisites
StrictPrerequisites.Hint: When enabled, the module refuses to add prestige classes, their features, specializations and techniques to characters who do not meet the prerequisites. Off by default so the GM decides admission.

Panel.Name: Grimoire automation panel
Panel.Label: Open panel
Panel.Hint: Auras, zones, summons, bonuses and the GM event queue.

Panel.Title: Grimoire — automation
Panel.Intro: {actor}. Refreshing does not change any documents.
Panel.AwaitingConfirmation: Waiting for the roll / damage to be confirmed
Panel.Dash: Dash: +{movement} {units} of movement; running long jump {jump} ft. Move manually.
Panel.DrainChecks: Distance and target eligibility are checked
Panel.ExpenseConfirmed: Cost confirmed; the result needs review
Panel.ExpenseUnconfirmed: Midi did not confirm the cost or the result
Panel.ZoneHidden: Hidden from players; its rules still apply

Queue.Title: Event queue (GM)
Queue.Intro: Another scene: open it first. An unknown outcome is reviewed by hand and never retried automatically.

Requests.NoOwnerPermission: You do not own the actor this request is for.
Requests.Pending: Request {id} is not confirmed yet. The cost was not refunded automatically; check the result in diagnostics.
Requests.NotOwned: A document in the request does not belong to the actor.
Requests.TokenMissing: The request's token was not found.
Requests.TargetsMissing: The request's targets were not found on the scene.
Requests.ZoneOwnToken: A zone can only be centred on the owner's token.
Requests.SpiritAlly: The spirit only protects an ally on its own scene.

TargetEffects.GmOnly: The GM applies this effect to creatures you do not own.
TargetEffects.NotAllowed: This effect cannot be applied at a player's request.
TargetEffects.SourceNotOwned: The effect's source does not belong to the actor.
TargetEffects.SourceCannot: This source cannot apply that effect.
TargetEffects.OtherScene: The targets must be on the source's scene.

Ledger.Queued: The trigger was saved in the Grimoire panel. The GM must open its scene and confirm the result.
Ledger.Interrupted: Interrupted by a reload or a GM change; it is never retried automatically.
Ledger.GmOnly: Only the active GM can manage the queue, with automation enabled.
